title: Operational resilience

story.need: deploy and recover the CMS predictably on one VPS
story.outcome: UAT and production remain independently verifiable and recoverable

scope: Automate validated database backups and retention
Monitor public health and MCP authorization challenges
Safely prune unused project image layers
Promote one immutable image from UAT to production
dataRequirements: Backup paths identify environment and UTC time
Deployment records image tag and image ID
permissions: Only the VPS operator can run backup, restore, and deployment commands

then: a private custom-format dump is written atomically
it restores into an isolated temporary database
the same image ID has passed UAT
both public health and MCP scope challenges pass after deployment
